harness_reachability.features: Use existing default production + local-only; dev-dependency mahayana-host/test-support is exactly the existing shipping test configuration.
harness_reachability.behavior: All ten selected cases use an explicit SurfacePlatform and test-owned storage. New three construct HostMode::Test first, then require Production/Electron refusal before absent real runtime, state lock, context I/O and events. No actual desktop hardware, display, account or OS keyring acquisition is needed by these fixtures.

harness_reachability.behavior: Nine cases use temporary real SQLite RuntimeStore with controlled Agent/Social providers and bounded runtime recovery; no production service.

harness_reachability.features: Package name differs from its directory: -p mahayana-platform-client is correct; source is mahayana-product.
harness_reachability.behavior: Six tests use isolated temporary client config, deterministic pre-credential refusal and 127.0.0.1:0 HTTP/redirect fixtures; no external account or production endpoint.

rationale.computer: mahayana-feature-host unconditionally depends on mahayana-computer; on Linux that crate selects enigo0.6.1 (wayland) and xcap0.9.8. Keep the established Computer compile dependencies even though no capture/input is invoked.
rationale.bindgen: Committed lock includes libspa-sys0.10.1 and pipewire-sys0.10.1 with bindgen/system-deps. libclang-dev and pkg-config make those native build prerequisites explicit.
rationale.sqlite: mahayana-runtime directly selects workspace rusqlite0.39 without bundled. Separate cargo invocations must not rely on FeatureHost's fabushi-messaging-core enabling bundled SQLite in another invocation; install libsqlite3-dev for the independent Runtime9 command.
rationale.compiler: Use the hosted Ubuntu C/C++ build toolchain. No cross compilation, Apple SDK, signing identity, Electron build, or production fixture is required.
rationale.secrets: mahayana-platform-client resolves Mahayana-owned auth/secrets; Linux keyring feature is linux-native-async-persistent with crypto-rust. Selected HTTP fixtures deny before credentials or use authenticated=false, so no running desktop secret-service/session bus is part of this contract scope.
rationale.display: No Xvfb, live PipeWire session, real capture device or desktop display is required for these three test filters; native development libraries are compile-time prerequisites.

minimum_workflow_change.path_reason: Existing paths cover feature-host and mahayana-product but omit runtime-only or workspace manifest changes. These two paths keep the new narrow gate reachable for its direct source inputs.
minimum_workflow_change.proposed_job_yaml:
native-social-directness-linux:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.message_batch
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: 2
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind exact Linux social contract source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${{ github.sha }}"
          mkdir -p artifacts/native-social-directness-linux
          git rev-parse HEAD > artifacts/native-social-directness-linux/target-sha.txt
          printf '%s\n' 'Ubuntu FeatureHost10/Runtime9/HTTP6 contract execution only; no macOS AppHost build, package, signing, real service, production fixture or independent acceptance.' > artifacts/native-social-directness-linux/scope.txt
          sha256sum source/mahayana/mahayana-rs/Cargo.lock source/mahayana/mahayana-rs/mahayana-feature-host/src/desktop_messaging_boundary_tests.rs source/mahayana/mahayana-rs/mahayana-runtime/src/retained_social_recovery_tests.rs source/mahayana/mahayana-rs/mahayana-product/src/lib.rs > artifacts/native-social-directness-linux/input-sha256.txt
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: source/mahayana/mahayana-rs -> target
          shared-key: native-social-directness-ubuntu-1.97.1
      - name: Install native Linux compile prerequisites
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends pkg-config libclang-dev libsqlite3-dev libwayland-dev libpipewire-0.3-dev libegl1-mesa-dev libegl-dev libgbm-dev libdrm-dev libxkbcommon-dev
      - name: Execute FeatureHost10 Runtime9 and HTTP6 with committed features
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence=artifacts/native-social-directness-linux
          rustc --version > "$evidence/toolchain.txt"
          cargo --version >> "$evidence/toolchain.txt"
          cargo test --locked --manifest-path source/mahayana/mahayana-rs/Cargo.toml -p mahayana-feature-host --lib desktop_messaging_boundary_tests -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/featurehost-messaging-boundary.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 10 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; [0-9]+ filtered out;' "$evidence/featurehost-messaging-boundary.log"
          cargo test --locked --manifest-path source/mahayana/mahayana-rs/Cargo.toml -p mahayana-runtime --lib retained_social_recovery_tests -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/social-recovery.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 9 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; [0-9]+ filtered out;' "$evidence/social-recovery.log"
          cargo test --locked --manifest-path source/mahayana/mahayana-rs/Cargo.toml -p mahayana-platform-client --lib session_owned_platform_ -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/social-http-owner.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 6 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; [0-9]+ filtered out;' "$evidence/social-http-owner.log"
          grep -Fx 'test implementation::desktop_messaging_boundary_tests::desktop_social_intents_refuse_before_auth_runtime_context_io_and_events ... ok' "$evidence/featurehost-messaging-boundary.log"
          grep -Fx 'test implementation::desktop_messaging_boundary_tests::desktop_social_refusal_does_not_lock_state_or_touch_retained_context ... ok' "$evidence/featurehost-messaging-boundary.log"
          grep -Fx 'test implementation::desktop_messaging_boundary_tests::social_boundary_keeps_explicit_test_non_desktop_and_other_namespaces ... ok' "$evidence/featurehost-messaging-boundary.log"
          git diff --exit-code -- source/mahayana/mahayana-rs/Cargo.lock
      - name: Preserve exact Linux social contract evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: native-social-directness-linux-${{ github.sha }}
          path: artifacts/native-social-directness-linux
          if-no-files-found: error
